name: bloodmesh
description: BloodMesh — a location-aware, real-time blood donor rescue network (MERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
